columns.codes: per point: base index (BASES rect or dome) | 100000 + base index (the deed cell) | 200000 + dy·cols + dx (open deed) | -1 nothing

mapPick: function pick(sx, sy) { const b = basesMod?.pick?.(sx, sy); if (b) return b; const [u, v] = cam.screenToDeed(sx, sy), x = Math.floor(u), y = Math.floor(v); if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= R.cols || y >= R.rows) return null; const hit = R.byCell.get(y * R.cols + x); if (hit) return hit; return P.first.deeds[y * R.cols + x] === DEED_PX.thisRealm ? { free: true, x, y } : null; }
note: map.js pick(): BASES pick first (keep/icon rects, largest seat y wins, then dome ellipses), then the deed cell. The pinned bases.js ran load(pack, shared) over the pinned keeps atlas (no decor, no realm art: neither moves a keep rect or a dome), setBases(bases), update(view), pick. Points: the grid (i + 0.5)·W/nx, (j + 0.5)·H/ny (index j·nx + i), then the edge probes (flat [sx, sy] pairs, index nx·ny + k): a quarter px either side of every tap region edge on the screen, found by marching pick() out of each keep rect and dome. A base id is its catalog tile id (native RealmGrid.tileId, x0/y0 below).
